name: AMD
column5: Committed $1B alongside NVIDIA's $3B into Meta's October 26, 2026 equity offering (per eWeek, citing NVIDIA/Meta announcements) -- a hyperscaler-customer balance-sheet stake, the same pattern that puts NVIDIA on this watchlist. Not currently tracked under any class.

name: Third Point
rationale: Led Nscale's $3.36B pre-IPO convertible-note round (announced 2026-09-25, already on file under NVIDIA's $1B tranche); Third Point itself is untracked but is becoming a recurring lead investor in AI-neocloud pre-IPO financings alongside corporate allocators.
